text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The new year has begun.
Starting this year, <chrname> is in the Senior Class."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the track, despite it being early morning,
the members of 'Project L'Arc'
were already putting in running laps."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Are you here to observe as well?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The number of supporters hasn't dropped.
We expect to provide the same level of backing as last year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I think we should start making our serious moves
beginning with the "Representative Exchange Match" in late March.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Until then, I want you to build up your strength and prepare for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
...Though I imagine you are already doing so.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
This year, let's make our dream a reality!
